note: Adapted from Emerson 1925; original in English; the OCR is largely clear, and the measurements are in mm as stated in the original. The original name is Mirotermes (Cavitermes) tuberosus, new species.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, oval, covered with short hairs and a few longer setae. Fontanelle small and inconspicuous. Antennae 15-segmented (one physogastric female complete), segment 3 very small, segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 2. Compound eyes rather small, not protruding, not very close to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli rather small and elongate, their distance from the compound eye less than their width. Postclypeus nearly concolorous with the head, about half as long as wide; median line present but faint. Pronotum dark brown, proportionally short and wide, sides rounded and convergent posteriorly, anterior angles rather acute, posterior margin very shallowly concave or not concave. Posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum broadly concave. Abdominal tergites as dark as the pronotum. Measurements: head length 1.23 mm, head width 1.03 mm, antennal length 1.66 mm, eye diameter 0.28 mm, pronotum length 0.50 mm, pronotum width 0.98 mm, hind tibia length 1.23 mm; body length of the physogastric female 8.00 mm, abdominal width 2.00 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head dark yellow, roughly rectangular in dorsal view but abruptly widened posteriorly, the posterior margin rounded; a distinct tubercle on each side of the vertex; a very deep depression at the middle in profile; the head extended anteriorly into an acute three-pointed process, the points sharp and upturned in profile; frons concave, with a distinct process on each side of the anteclypeus. Antennae concolorous with the head, 14-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 3 as long as segment 4, segment 5 more than twice as long as segment 4. Labrum with 2 points, the anterior margin slightly concave, the sides convergent posteriorly. Mandibles similar to those of the subgenus Mirotermes, of the snapping type, with a short blunt tooth near the base followed by an upturned, relatively longer tooth. Pronotum pale, the anterior margin evenly rounded. Legs pale. Abdomen taking the colour of the gut contents, the tergites hairy. Measurements: body length 5.00—6.00 mm, head length including the mandibles 3.43 mm, head length to the tip of the rostral process 1.67—1.77 mm, head width 1.10—1.17 mm, antennal length 2.20 mm, pronotum width 0.63—0.67 mm, hind tibia length 0.87 mm, left mandible length 1.93 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality: Barakara, Bartica district, British Guiana; other localities: Cow Island (Bartica district), British Guiana, and St. Joseph, Trinidad; distribution: British Guiana and Trinidad. The description is based on one physogastric female and several soldiers from one nest at Barakara, one king and one queen with several soldiers from one nest on Cow Island, and 2 soldiers collected by Emerson in one nest in Trinidad; the holotype is a soldier and the morphotype a physogastric female. The specific name refers to the few tubercles on the vertex and on the sides of the clypeus. The original places the species under the new subgenus Cavitermes of Mirotermes.
